cardinality.rule: setProperties: colormap.opacity: its value is not a number or a list that the file shows, colormap.opacity is gone: a number is the opacity of the appearance (opacity beside the colormap), a list of { value, opacity } points is colormap.opacityMapping

setProperties: colormap.opacity: the colormap has an opacityMapping too, colormap.opacity is gone: a number is the opacity of the appearance (opacity beside the colormap), a list of { value, opacity } points is colormap.opacityMapping
